hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Think of money: you owe $5$ dollars and then earn $8$ dollars. After paying what you owe, how much is left?
Adding a positive number means moving right on the number line. Think about where you start and which direction you travel.
Start at $-5$ and move $8$ steps right. The first $5$ steps bring you to $0$, so work out how many steps are left to take past $0$.
There are $8 - 5 = 3$ steps left after reaching $0$, so $-5 + 8 = 3$.

explanation: Adding $8$ means moving $8$ units to the right on the number line, starting from $-5$.
It takes $5$ of those units to get from $-5$ up to $0$.
The remaining $8 - 5 = 3$ units carry you to the right of $0$, landing on $3$.
So the sum $-5 + 8$ is equal to $3$.
